core.title: Offset Flush Door Pull, Rockwood 94L
tags: Contemporary Rectangular Satin Stainless Steel Flush Pulls

text.description_html:
Rockwood 94L, Contemporary Satin Stainless Steel Cup Pull

The Offset Flush Door Pull is for use on pocket doors, sliding doors, cabinet doors--any door where a flush with the door face pull is desired. The Rockwood 94L Satin Stainless Steel finish makes it great for high traffic doors and for homes with a modern design aesthetic. Easy to install, it is packaged as a complete set with mounting hardware for one side of a pocket door.

Specifications for the Offset Flush Pull:

  • Material: .125" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 5"
  • Total Width: 3-1/2"
  • Total Depth: 7/8"
  • Mounting Hole Depth: 3/8"
  • Projection: 7/16"
  • Packaged with matching satin stainless mounting screws.

Sold Individually
